name: AIIcon
description: Wraps any icon component with sizing, colour treatment, semantic tone, an optional container and motion. Governed by the 60-30-10 rule.
intent: A treatment layer over standard icons — not a new icon set.

authority.note: src/ is authoritative. If this contract disagrees with the source, implement from the source and report the drift.

props.name: size
props.hint: See sizeGuidance in the mirror spec.

props.name: treatment
props.hint: One of the treatment values declared in aiIconVariants.

props.name: tone
props.hint: One of the tone values declared in aiIconVariants.

props.name: container
props.hint: One of the container values declared in aiIconVariants.

props.name: motion
props.hint: One of the motion values declared in aiIconVariants.

props.name: icon
props.hint: Required. Declared in the component source.

props.name: label
props.hint: Not an icon set — a treatment layer over whatever icon you pass. The 60-30-10 rule governs it: about 60% of icons on a surface should be neutral, 30% semantic, and only 10% carry the AI identity colour. Treat `treatment="ai"` as a scarce resource; if every icon is an AI icon, none is. / const aiIconVariants = cva("inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center", { variants: { size: { xs: "[&_svg]:size-3", sm: "[&_svg]:size-4", md: "[&_svg]:size-5", lg: "[&_svg]:size-6", xl: "[&_svg]:size-8", }, treatment: { neutral: "text-muted-foreground", ai: "text-ai-accent", "ai-contained": "rounded-lg bg-ai-surface text-ai-accent", semantic: "", "orange-signal": "text-ai-signal", }, tone: { default: "", success: "text-ai-confidence-high", warning: "text-ai-signal", error: "text-destructive", blocked: "text-destructive", escalated: "text-ai-signal", }, container: { true: "p-1.5", false: "", }, motion: { none: "", spin: "[&_svg]:animate-spin motion-reduce:[&_svg]:animate-none", pulse: "[&_svg]:animate-pulse motion-reduce:[&_svg]:animate-none", }, }, defaultVariants: { size: "md", treatment: "neutral", tone: "default", container: false, motion: "none", }, }) export interface AIIconProps extends Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>, "children">, VariantProps<typeof aiIconVariants> { icon: React.ComponentType<{ className?: string }> /** Required unless decorative. An icon with meaning and no name is invisible.

props.name: decorative
props.hint: Optional. Declared in the component source.

props.name: className
props.hint: Merged with the component classes via cn(). Use for layout only — never to override a variant that already exists.

requiredAttributes: Either label or decorative — one of the two, always
notes: Setting neither logs a development warning. An icon with meaning and no name is invisible.
Motion must reflect real activity. A permanently spinning icon is noise that trains users to ignore it.

agentRules: Set either label or decorative on every instance.
Reserve orange-signal for review and escalation.

gaps: The handoff-trail, completion-settle, nudge, shimmer and alert-ring motions from the source system are not implemented. Only spin and pulse.
